arguments.summary: Plan: assess ANET—not a live executable quote—using the 2026-10-02 completed close as the market anchor and distinguish outcomes over 5, 21 and 63 sessions. Integrate the already-assigned Company, Macro, Technical, Geopolitics and Commodities work plus the completed independent Challenger review; no duplicate assignments are made. Company supplies the operating-to-EPS bridge and one deterministic bear/base/bull P/E sensitivity grid. Macro evaluates rate/order-demand transmission. Technical evaluates leadership, relative path risk versus SPY/XLK, and qualified historical regime frequencies. Geopolitics tests policy, geography/customer/supply-chain exposure without assuming applicability or quantifying undisclosed exposure. Commodities tests input, logistics and energy-price channels, including whether they are immaterial. Final synthesis will reconcile conflicts, state conditional outcomes rather than probabilities, and provide observable review triggers for each horizon.
assumptions: The specialist assignments shown as pending will complete within the shared research budget.
The final assessment will use the completed 2026-10-02 split-adjusted ANET close, not the stale single-venue IEX snapshot, as its dated market anchor.
Scenario EPS and P/E inputs will be stated assumptions rather than consensus or observed forward valuation facts.
arguments.counter_thesis: A short-horizon conclusion could be dominated by a new earnings, policy, or macro development after the recorded close; the plan therefore treats specialist evidence as dated and conditions any directional judgment on its stated assumptions.

review_conditions.description: Reassess the integrated view when the next issuer results/outlook, a material policy change affecting relevant advanced-computing trade, or a material move in rates and ANET relative performance provides evidence that changes the operating, valuation, policy, or market-behavior mechanisms used in the final assessment.

agent_report.work_summary: Defined the decision frame, evidence clocks, required specialist integration, and stopping discipline. I did not perform duplicate specialist research or make new assignments because all five specialist roles are already assigned by the controller.
main_conclusions: Use the 2026-10-02 completed close rather than the stale, single-venue snapshot as the dated market reference.
The Company role must provide the deterministic earnings/multiple sensitivity; other roles test the global transmission channels and market path.
Policy and commodity conclusions must remain conditional if issuer-specific exposure or pass-through is unquantified.
Final judgment should reconcile the Challenger and all five specialist outputs rather than infer direction from a single recent price move.
agent_report.short_summary: The research plan is to combine issuer fundamentals, valuation sensitivity, macro and policy channels, technical path risk, and commodity exposure into conditional 5/21/63-session outcomes. No duplicate work is assigned.
limitations: This is a planning submission, not a final investment assessment.
No new specialist findings were available in this task; valuation and global conclusions await the routed role outputs.
The IEX snapshot is market-closed, stale and single-venue, so it is not an executable or consolidated quote.
